items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Cecil McBee in the context of a performance at Carnegie Hall and as a bass player whose style he observes ('Cecil McBee goes out a little bit'), but does not explicitly state a personal relationship, collaboration, or mentorship.

ctx.x: -- and Cecil at Carnegie Hall, you know?
Well, I guess she was curious.
